hero.title: GET IN TOUCH
hero.sub: Have questions, want to book us for an event, or looking to franchise? We'd love to hear from you.

event_bar.title: 🎪 BOOK OUR LIVE CANE BAR
event_bar.sub: Bring authentic freshly pressed sugarcane juice to your wedding, birthday, corporate event, or festival.
highlights: Live cold-pressing on-site before your guests
100% natural pure sugarcane juice — nothing added
Custom flavor bar (Lemon, Ginger, Mint, Masala & Mix Fruit)

faqs.question: How do I book The Cane House for my wedding or party?
faqs.answer: Simply fill out the form above with your event date, location, and estimated guest count. Our team will get back to you within 24 hours with package options and availability.

faqs.question: What is included with the live sugarcane bar?
faqs.answer: Our live bar includes our traditional press machine, trained baristas, fresh premium sugarcane stalks, biodegradable cups, and a full range of natural flavor infusions.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.answer: We recommend booking at least 2 to 4 weeks in advance during peak summer and wedding seasons to secure your preferred date.

faqs.question: Where are you currently serving?
faqs.answer: We are based in Sutton, London, and cater across Greater London, Surrey, and surrounding areas. For larger events and franchises, nationwide service is available.
